sourceV3.Match_Evidence: Same Mendeley DOI (10.17632/27c8pwsd6v) in all three records; same title; all describe a derived/edited road damage and defect collection built from RDD2022.
sourceV3.Platform_Relationship: Single Mendeley deposit; also surfaced by GitHub-batch search
sourceV3.Publication_Dataset_Relationship: Reported in source record (relationship not classified)
sourceV3.Country: India; Japan; Czech Republic; Norway; China; United States (inherited from the RDD2022 source imagery) [Claude] | Multi-country; derived from RDD2022 and edited data [GPT] | Multiple; derived from RDD2022 [GPT]
sourceV3.Geographic_Coverage: India; Japan; Czech Republic; Norway; China; United States (inherited from the RDD2022 source imagery) [Claude] | Multi-country; derived from RDD2022 and edited data [GPT] | Multiple; derived from RDD2022 [GPT]; Road environment: Urban road; Rural road; Highway [Claude] | Road networks [GPT] | Mixed [GPT]
sourceV3.Acquisition_Platform: Vehicle-mounted smartphone (inherited from RDD2022) [Claude] | Derived/edited road-image collection [GPT] | Derived from RDD2022 and edited/updated data [GPT]
sourceV3.Distress_Types: Longitudinal crack (D00); Transverse crack (D10); Alligator crack (D20); Repaired crack (D30); Pothole (D40); Pedestrian crossing blur (D50); Lane line blur (D60); Manhole cover (D70); Patchy road section (D80); Rutting (D90) [Claude] | Ten road-defect types; exact controlled list NR [GPT] | ten road damage and defect types [GPT]
sourceV3.Label_Taxonomy: 10 defect classes, expanded and re-edited from the 4-class RDD2022 labelling [Claude] | Expanded from four to ten defect types [GPT] | Ten-class expanded taxonomy; exact labels NR [GPT]
sourceV3.Annotation_Source: Manual re-annotation of RDD2022 imagery [Claude] | Edited and updated derivative dataset [GPT] | Edited and relabeled derivative dataset [GPT]
sourceV3.AI_Task_Evidence: Reported on the source record/data card or associated publication (see Evidence_Locator)
sourceV3.Key_Limitations: Derived from RDD2022 imagery, so it is not an independent sample and inherits any upstream labelling error; image and per-class instance counts, resolution and annotation format are all unreported; five versions exist with no changelog; the only associated publication located is an SSRN preprint, not a peer-reviewed article [Claude] | Derivative identity and overlap with RDD2022 require file-level audit; critical counts, taxonomy, license, and provenance are incompletely documented in retrieved evidence [GPT] | Derivative provenance and relabeling procedure insufficiently documented; exact count, license, and QC unresolved [GPT]
